title: monardella odoratissima subsp. pinetorum
intro: Monardella odoratissima subsp. pinetorum, commonly known as Pine Mountain Mountain Monardella, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and Mexico, valued for its fragrance and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Monardella odoratissima subsp. pinetorum include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, with therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
